basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. I recently embarked on a journey into the world of stock trading, particularly interested in the EV market. By day, I work as a junior software developer, and by night, I dive into Reddit discussions to learn more about investment strategies. I'm single and spend my evenings browsing Reddit and watching tech reviews on YouTube. I usually go online between 7 PM and midnight CST. My interests include electric vehicles, emerging tech, and strategy games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I come from a tech background with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science. My interest in stocks is relatively new, sparked by conversations with friends who are seasoned investors. I rely on online resources, Reddit threads, and YouTube channels to self-educate on trading.
